text:
net decorations

(queued) -job-> [start] -job-> (running)
@done_in: (running) -job-> [finish]
[finish] -receipt-> (done)
@done_in predicate cel "job.exitCode == 0"

decorate [start] highlight "R2.11"
decorate (running) highlight
decorate (running) note "one worker at a time"
decorate @done_in summary "succeeded"
decorate @done_in note "see R2.3"
decorate [finish] summary "writes the receipt"
decorate color job quiet
decorate color job show "id" "owner.name"
